dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、先輩、せんぱ〜い！！」
dialogues.en: "What? My tail?"
dialogues.text: "What? My tail?"

dialogues.jp:
ガララっと扉が開き、耳を右から左へ突き抜け
ていく呼び声。
dialogues.en: Turning around, Miharu tries to look for her tail.
dialogues.text: Turning around, Miharu tries to look for her tail.

dialogues.jp: 「何だよ、美春。ぱたぱた尻尾なんぞ振って」
dialogues.en: "Hey, just kidding."
dialogues.text: "Hey, just kidding."

dialogues.jp:
首を折り曲げ、くるくると周りながら、自分の
尻を見ようとする。
dialogues.en: I turn around my chair to look at Miharu.
dialogues.text: I turn around my chair to look at Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、その……ただの冗談だ」
dialogues.en: "What's going on? You're in a rush. "
dialogues.text: "What's going on? You're in a rush. "

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「コレですよ、これこれ」
dialogues.en: "This one... This one..."
dialogues.text: "This one... This one..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、がさごそとポケットをあさるが――
dialogues.en: Miharu is rummaging around her pockets for something.
dialogues.text: Miharu is rummaging around her pockets for something.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ん？　ありゃりゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? Where is it...?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? Where is it...?"

dialogues.jp:
餅のようにポケットの底を伸ばし、ついで身体
のあちこちを触る。
dialogues.en:
She turns her pockets inside out and then starts to pat down
her body.
dialogues.text:
She turns her pockets inside out and then starts to pat down
her body.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？　落とし物か？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? Lost something?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? Lost something?"

dialogues.jp:
よく分からないが、ともかく、何かを探してい
るらしい。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what's going on, but she's obviously looking
for something.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what's going on, but she's obviously looking
for something.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょ、ちょっと待っててくださいね！」
dialogues.en: "Wait! Please wait here!"
dialogues.text: "Wait! Please wait here!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おおっ」
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど世界新とも言うべきスピードで、部屋
を出ていってしまう。
dialogues.en: She rushes out of the room at full speed.
dialogues.text: She rushes out of the room at full speed.

dialogues.jp: 「……騒がしい奴」
dialogues.en: "Such a noisy girl..."
dialogues.text: "Such a noisy girl..."

dialogues.jp:
ディスプレイに向きなおり、再びバイトにいそ
しみ始めたところで、騒音の源が戻ってきた。
dialogues.en:
As I turn back to work, I hear the source of the noise
coming back.
dialogues.text:
As I turn back to work, I hear the source of the noise
coming back.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ありました、ありました、ありました〜！」
dialogues.en: "I got it. I got it. I got it!"
dialogues.text: "I got it. I got it. I got it!"

dialogues.jp:
“勝訴！”の紙を掲げる弁護士のように、両手
を前に突き出している。
dialogues.en: Miharu punches the air in triumph.
dialogues.text: Miharu punches the air in triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「危ない危ない。廊下の隅に丸まってましたけ
　れど、美春のＸ線アイはそれを見逃しません
　でしたよ」
dialogues.en:
"Close call. It was rolling on the floor at the corner of
the hallway. But my X-ray eyes didn't overlook it!"
dialogues.text:
"Close call. It was rolling on the floor at the corner of
the hallway. But my X-ray eyes didn't overlook it!"

dialogues.jp: こいつ、そんな機能を持っていたのか？
dialogues.en: Does she really have X-ray eyes?
dialogues.text: Does she really have X-ray eyes?

dialogues.jp: 「で、何だよ？」
dialogues.en: "So what is it?"
dialogues.text: "So what is it?"

dialogues.jp:
さっきから騒がしいばっかりで、一向に話が見
えてこない。
dialogues.en: I have no idea what she's up to...
dialogues.text: I have no idea what she's up to...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、先輩。どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, here you go."
dialogues.text: "Sempai, here you go."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、｛しわ／皺｝だらけの紙片を渡してくる。そ
れも、２枚――。
dialogues.en:
Miharu gives me two pieces of paper that are covered with
wrinkles.
dialogues.text:
Miharu gives me two pieces of paper that are covered with
wrinkles.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
紙片に視線を落とす。そこには、何やら色鉛筆
で書かれた文字が踊っていて……、
dialogues.en:
I look at one of the pieces of paper. It's got a message
written on it in colored pencils.
dialogues.text:
I look at one of the pieces of paper. It's got a message
written on it in colored pencils.

dialogues.jp: 「“お誕生日会招待券”……？」
dialogues.en: "Birthday Party Invitation...?"
dialogues.text: "Birthday Party Invitation...?"

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げて美春を見る。美春のにこにことした
笑顔は、太陽のように輝いていた。
dialogues.en: Miharu gives me a sunshine-like smile.
dialogues.text: Miharu gives me a sunshine-like smile.

dialogues.en: "Whose party?"
dialogues.text: "Whose party?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜！　酷い〜！　先輩ったら、忘れてる！」
dialogues.en: "Ahh! You're so cruel. You don't remember?!!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh! You're so cruel. You don't remember?!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Come on!!"
dialogues.text: "Come on!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……美春の誕生日か？」
dialogues.en: "Your birthday?"
dialogues.text: "Your birthday?"

dialogues.jp:
思い出したわけではないが、たぶんそんなとこ
ろだろう。
dialogues.en: Actually, I still don't remember, but what else can I say?
dialogues.text: Actually, I still don't remember, but what else can I say?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうです！　そう、そう、正解！」
dialogues.en: "That's right!!"
dialogues.text: "That's right!!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……でも、『美春さん』は先輩と仲良かった
　んですよねえ？」
dialogues.en: "I thought you and Miharu-san were close friends..."
dialogues.text: "I thought you and Miharu-san were close friends..."

dialogues.jp: 言外に、忘れたことをちくちくと突いてくる。
dialogues.en: I know what Miharu's trying to imply.
dialogues.text: I know what Miharu's trying to imply.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、気にするな。地球上では年に６０億回
　も誕生日が迎えられているんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. There are as many as 5 billion people on this
earth celebrating their birthdays throughout the year."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. There are as many as 5 billion people on this
earth celebrating their birthdays throughout the year."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「関係ありませんよ……」
dialogues.en: "What's that got to do with me?"
dialogues.text: "What's that got to do with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、確かに。……しかし、招待券と来たか」
dialogues.en: "Nothing... But... an invitation..."
dialogues.text: "Nothing... But... an invitation..."

dialogues.jp: 発想が子供っぽくて、何だか微笑ましい。
dialogues.en: It's a bit childish, but kind of cute...
dialogues.text: It's a bit childish, but kind of cute...

dialogues.jp:
それは、モノ自体はただの紙だが、美春の手に
よるデザインはかなり凝っていて、｛しわしわ／皺々｝なのが
いっそ物悲しかった。
dialogues.en: There are pictures on the invitation that Miharu designed.
dialogues.text: There are pictures on the invitation that Miharu designed.

dialogues.jp:
しかも手書きなので、作るのにかなり時間を要
したはずだ。
dialogues.en:
The pictures are all hand-drawn by her. She must've spent a
lot of time on this.
dialogues.text:
The pictures are all hand-drawn by her. She must've spent a
lot of time on this.

dialogues.jp:
小綺麗な枠の中には、日時と場所が記されてい
る。――明後日の１６日。美春の家。
dialogues.en:
The card says the date, time and place. The party is on the
16th -- the day after tomorrow. At Miharu's house.
dialogues.text:
The card says the date, time and place. The party is on the
16th -- the day after tomorrow. At Miharu's house.

dialogues.jp:
「何だよ、もうすぐじゃんか。もっと早く言っ
　てくれれば良かったのに」
dialogues.en: "It's soon. Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
dialogues.text: "It's soon. Why didn't you tell me earlier?"

dialogues.jp: まともにプレゼントを選ぶ時間もなさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
I might not have enough time to shop for her birthday
present.
dialogues.text:
I might not have enough time to shop for her birthday
present.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「その……ちょっと、それを作るのに手間取っ
　てしまいまして……」
dialogues.en: "It took a bit longer to finish the cards than I'd planned."
dialogues.text: "It took a bit longer to finish the cards than I'd planned."

dialogues.jp:
“ちょっと”の部分にタメを作りつつ、親指と
人差し指の間に隙間を作った。
dialogues.en: She emphasizes the word 'bit' by gesturing with her fingers.
dialogues.text: She emphasizes the word 'bit' by gesturing with her fingers.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、何で２枚くれるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you giving me two cards?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you giving me two cards?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「その……音夢先輩を誘ってもらいたいんです」
dialogues.en:
"Uh... I'm hoping you could invite Nemu-sempai to the
party."
dialogues.text:
"Uh... I'm hoping you could invite Nemu-sempai to the
party."

dialogues.jp:
深くうなずいて、何となく、２枚の紙片を擦り
合わせた。
dialogues.en: I nod deeply while rubbing the edges of the cards.
dialogues.text: I nod deeply while rubbing the edges of the cards.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩方の他にも、友達は来てくれますけれど
　……やっぱり、おふたりには参加してもらい
　たいんです」
dialogues.en:
"Other friends will be coming too, but I really want you and
Nemu-sempai to come."
dialogues.text:
"Other friends will be coming too, but I really want you and
Nemu-sempai to come."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……了解。誘っておくよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'll ask her."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'll ask her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます！」
dialogues.en: "Thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you!"

dialogues.jp:
それこそ尻尾を振っているような勢いで、俺の
両手をぎゅっと握りしめてくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu jumps up and clasps my hands.
dialogues.text: Miharu jumps up and clasps my hands.

dialogues.jp:
その汗ばんだ温かさに、俺は少しだけどきりと
してしまった。
dialogues.en:
The feel of her warm, sweaty hands makes my heart leap a
bit.
dialogues.text:
The feel of her warm, sweaty hands makes my heart leap a
bit.

dialogues.jp: ◆招待券◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu◆

dialogues.jp: 美春から誕生会の招待券を２枚もらった。
dialogues.en: The door opens with a squeaky voice.
dialogues.text: The door opens with a squeaky voice.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら音夢も誘って欲しいらしい。承諾する
と、それこそ尻尾を振っているような勢いで、
俺の両手をぎゅっと握りしめてきたのだった。
dialogues.en:
"What happened, Miharu? You look like you're wagging your
tail!"
dialogues.text:
"What happened, Miharu? You look like you're wagging your
tail!"
